output.reason: The linked PR identifies the subject as Crossplane's own E2E test harness. Its gotestsum re-run setting (up to 3 retries) combined with `--fail-fast` meant that after a flaky test failed and then passed on re-run, the remaining tests never ran, so many E2E tests went unrun for months [ev-af4c429f9578][ev-eba58baf96c5]. All 18 changed files are CI or test files (.github/workflows/ci.yml, Earthfile, test/e2e/... files and manifests), with no product code [ev-4db6d95d6485]. That is enough to write the assertion: an internal CI/test change that exposes no customer environment and has no consequence for an operator who does nothing, even though the shown excerpts cut off before stating the exact fix.
